lines.zh: 我摆尾的节奏像在唱歌。
lines.en: My tail beats as if in song.

lines.zh: 鳞片在深水里一闪一闪。
lines.en: Scales flicker in the deep water.

lines.zh: 我贴着沉船的舷边游过。
lines.en: I glide past the wreck's railing.
The weeds sway where I pass.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，好让你看清。
lines.en: I swim slowly so you can see me.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍扫过一片珊瑚。
lines.en: My tail fin brushes the coral.
My white hair spreads wide in the water.
I circle the sunken ship once.
In storms I swim closer to shore.
I make the water sound quieter on purpose.
I sink down along a shaft of light.

lines.zh: 气泡从我发间一路往上飘。
lines.en: Bubbles trail from my hair behind me.
Fish stop moving as I pass.
I know this trench better than anyone.

lines.zh: 雷声一响，我就往水面靠近。
lines.en: At the first thunder, I rise toward the surface.

lines.zh: 我的手指拨开海水，一路向前。
lines.en: My fingers part the water ahead of me.

lines.zh: 雨点砸下来，水里的路更清。
lines.en: Rain strikes down, and the path below grows clearer.

lines.zh: 我顺着沉船的木梁往上滑。
lines.en: I slide up along a sunken ship's beam.

lines.zh: 我哼一段只有自己懂的调子。
lines.en: I hum something only I understand.

lines.zh: 我用手指梳过自己的头发。
lines.en: I comb my hair through my fingers.

lines.zh: 我对着沉船的镜子看自己。
lines.en: I look at myself in the wreck's mirror.
The prismarine on my neck glows.
I am waiting for the next ship.

lines.zh: 我数着海面落下的雨点。
lines.en: I count the raindrops striking the surface.
A heart in my chest, like a second one.
I blow a bubble just to pop it.
The fish gather around me and stay.
I do not want to eat anything.
I press each scale flat.

lines.zh: 海里太安静，我唱低一点。
lines.en: The sea is too quiet, so I sing lower.
I hear oars in the distance.
I smile, and the water does not stir.
You finally look down at me.
I am prettier than you imagined.
Do not look away. I worked for this.

lines.zh: 你的脸在水里有点变形。
lines.en: Your face is a little warped down here.
I sing, only for you.
Did you see my scales?

lines.zh: 我游到你的视线正中间。
lines.en: I swim into the exact center of your sight.
Your friends are calling. You cannot hear them.
I blink, and the water moves with me.
Watch a while longer and you cannot leave.
You knocked off my scales.
A strand of my hair broke.
It hurts, and my song stops.
You actually dared to strike me.
There is red in the water. Hard to wash.
That made me ugly.
I retreat half a wreck's length.
Do not touch my face.

lines.zh: 你的脸，我记进鳞片里了。
lines.en: Your face is written on my scales.
You are crueler than I thought.
I will not eat that fish of yours.
The light you carry is better bait.
Lift the lamp higher. Let me see.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只是想留住你。
lines.en: I am not hungry. I only want you to stay.
Your heartbeat tastes better than fish.
That tropical fish is far too small.

lines.zh: 你拿食物哄我，真没意思。
lines.en: Offering me food is dull.
I would rather you stayed.
Put the fish away and come with me.
I do not eat fish. I eat time.
You touched my tail fin.
My scales scraped your hand.
Do not push; there is nowhere to hide.
I press against you, and you stay.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你的灯晃了一下。
lines.en: That bump made your lamp sway.

lines.zh: 我的头发缠在你肩上了。
lines.en: My hair is tangled on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你不用道歉，我喜欢这样。
lines.en: No need to apologize. I like it.
We knock together, very gently.

lines.zh: 你穿的这身盔甲是凉的。
lines.en: The armor you wear is cold.
Come closer and I will not let go.
Storm night, and no one on the water.
Listen. My tune has changed.
My kin scattered long ago.
If you stay, that counts as a promise.

lines.zh: 我把颈上的海晶给你看。
lines.en: I show you the prismarine at my throat.
Let us circle the wreck three times.
When I sing, you should close your eyes.
This sea can feed two of us.
I do not bite. I pull.
Slow down. I have not done this in years.
I will keep this coin.

lines.zh: 我捡起你的灯，看里面的火。
lines.en: I pick up your lamp to see the flame.

lines.zh: 沉船里的东西都是我的。
lines.en: Everything in the wreck is mine.
I string prismarine shards into a chain.

lines.zh: 这块镜子碎了，还是好看。
lines.en: This mirror is cracked and still lovely.

lines.zh: 我捡起一片鳞，放回身上。
lines.en: I pick up a scale and set it back on me.

lines.zh: 你掉了东西，我替你收着。
lines.en: You dropped something. I picked it up.
I do not need it. I just like taking.
This ring is too small.
I set it down on the coral.
That song you hear is me.
You have already swum too deep.

lines.zh: 我顺着你的呼吸找过来。
lines.en: I followed the sound of your breathing.
I have pulled this line for years.
Your ship went down. You stayed.
I chose you, not the others.

lines.zh: 我唱到第三个音你就转了。
lines.en: You turned at my third note.
Do not go up. It is raining there.
You no longer remember the way.
I am right beneath you.

lines.zh: 我唱得很轻，你听得更清。
lines.en: I sing softly, and you hear it clearer.
You are swimming down. Good.

lines.zh: 我在你影子里轻轻摆尾。
lines.en: I beat my tail gently in your shadow.
Your lamp is going out.

lines.zh: 再唱一句，你就到我这了。
lines.en: One more verse and you reach me.
I do not chase. I wait for you.
There is no path left behind you.
The surface is far. Have you counted?
I reach out my hand before your eyes.
Keep your eyes open. Watch my face.

lines.zh: 我的指甲很长，你忍一下。
lines.en: My nails are long. Bear with it.

lines.zh: 这一下，是为了让你留下。
lines.en: This one is to make you stay.
I have hold of your ankle.
What leaves you is red.
I dislike getting my hands dirty.
The more you pull, the tighter I hold.
This bite is a gentle one.
I drag you down.
You dropped your lamp. Perfect.
Do not blame me. You came down.

lines.zh: 雷雨把海面砸得看不见。
lines.en: Storm rain pounds the surface blind.

lines.zh: 我从沉船的舱口游出来。
lines.en: I swim out of the wreck's hatch.
Someone is singing. It is me.

lines.zh: 海沟里的水忽然变甜了。
lines.en: The trench water suddenly turns sweet.
I sit on the bow and wait for dawn.

lines.zh: 鳞片先亮，然后我才出现。
lines.en: My scales light first, then I appear.

lines.zh: 这一带又要沉一条船了。
lines.en: Another ship will sink here soon.
The rain drowns out my tune.
I rise and watch the lightning.
You are lucky, and you are not.

lines.zh: 火在水里不灭，在我鳞上。
lines.en: Fire will not die here; it sits on my scales.

lines.zh: 我摔进礁石缝，尾鳍卡住。
lines.en: I fall into a rock crack; my fin is stuck.

lines.zh: 我在水里唱歌，也会没气。
lines.en: I sing underwater, yet I still lose air.

lines.zh: 炸开的碎片划花了我的鳞。
lines.en: The blast's shards scratch my scales.

lines.zh: 箭插在我身上，像枚簪子。
lines.en: The arrow sits in me like a hairpin.
That light laid my face bare.
I do not eat, but I still weaken.
Lightning shows what I really look like.
Below is dark, without even a song.
